name: system_info
description: Get system information: CPU, memory, disk usage, OS details, GPU.

manual.overview: Use when you need to diagnose system health, debug performance issues, or verify hardware resources before running heavy tasks.

examples.description: Get full system snapshot (CPU, RAM, disk, OS, GPU) for diagnostics
Check available disk space before running large builds or downloads

tips: Call early when troubleshooting slowdowns or out-of-memory errors
Use to validate environment before suggesting resource-intensive operations
Compare metrics across runs to spot degradation trends
edge_cases: GPU info may be absent on headless or non-GPU systems
Disk percentages can lag briefly after large file operations
